title: Extended Sunday and Boxing Day trading (SA)
summary: The Shop Trading Hours (Extension of Hours) Amendment Act 2022 allowed Adelaide shops to open from 9am on Sundays and suburban shops to trade on Boxing Day, from 1 November 2022.

instruments.title: Shop Trading Hours (Extension of Hours) Amendment Act 2022

commenced.what: Act proclaimed to commence; first 9am Sunday trading 6 Nov 2022

direction_rationale: Longer permitted trading hours let smaller and new retailers compete with incumbents on convenience and give consumers more choice; the PC recommended full deregulation. Effects may favour large chains able to staff extra hours.
comparison: WA and QLD (unchanged in 2022); earlier SA years

assessment.summary: Allowed Adelaide shops to open from 9am on Sundays and suburban shops on Boxing Day. The Productivity Commission has recommended removing trading hours restrictions altogether.

marks.reason: Longer permitted hours let retailers compete on convenience and give shoppers more choice.
